story: It is Dan's birthday today. He and Aiko sit near a small table to eat snacks. Aiko puts butter on the bread, and Dan finds a carrot under his chair. A small pig runs off the table. They just want to close the door and wait.
title: A Birthday Snack
setting: A bright kitchen with a wooden table.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress

sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt, smiles happily.

sentences.en: Aiko and Dan come into the kitchen.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress, and Dan walk into a kitchen.

sentences.en: They sit near a small wooden table.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在一个小木桌旁边。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko and Dan sit on chairs near a small wooden table.

sentences.en: Aiko puts butter on the bread.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko spreads yellow butter on a slice of bread on the table.

sentences.en: They eat all the small snacks.
sentences.zh: 他们吃掉了所有的这些小零食。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko are eating snacks from plates on the table.

sentences.en: Dan finds a carrot under his chair.
sentences.zh: Dan在他的椅子下面发现了一个胡萝卜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan leans down to look under his wooden chair and sees an orange carrot.

sentences.en: A small pig runs off the table.
sentences.zh: 一只小猪从桌子上跑了下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small pink pig jumps off the wooden table onto the floor.

sentences.en: They just want to close the door.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想要把门关上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko look at the open door and want to shut it.

sentences.en: They wait for the hungry animal.
sentences.zh: 他们等待着那只饥饿的动物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan and Aiko sit quietly and look at the small pink pig on the floor.
